data_inputs.known_definition: UTC close of the W-minute candle; touch bars use native 5m opens.
data_inputs.wait_definition: Completed lower-touch bars with opens in [known, decision); decision=known+wait_min.
data_inputs.membership_rule: Unique initial lower-touch symbols in [known-W, known); earliest touch supplies level when a W group straddles a weekly seam.
data_inputs.monitor_fraction_definition: Share of scheduled 5m opens in [known-W, decision) outside New York Monday; initial and wait components are also emitted.
data_inputs.first_last_half_definition: Distinct new symbols by earliest wait touch, split at known+wait_min/2; first half is left-closed/right-open.
data_inputs.market_share_definition: initial / number of distinct symbols with any-direction ledger touch known in the trailing 28 days through known; percentage, a causal activity-universe proxy, not a complete live listing census.
data_inputs.history_age_definition: Days since the symbol's first observed first-touch event in the available frozen-plus-extension ledger; not a listing-age claim.
data_inputs.shock_definition: Age at known of the latest native 5m same-side (or any-side) first-touch bar with at least 25 distinct symbols, strictly before known; missing age has explicit no-prior-in-available-ledger status and is left-censored.
data_inputs.weekly_opportunity_coverage_caveat: Coverage file is a source diagnostic only; full-week admitted/no-touch status is not used as a causal market-share denominator.

note: Replace python with interpreter above, run in the shared main checkout with the registered external cold-data volume mounted. Source candle/constituent matrices persist in place. Fresh quoted dollar results require the same raw options, source receipts and funding snapshots. Public API and monthly archives are recorded separately when REST is unavailable.
null_hypothesis: No excess realized net return over matched long positions. Deterministic rule screen, no fitted binary classifier; classifier AUC/top-decile prediction ranks do not apply. Test-month sign flip preserves correlated market episodes; check Holm by four targets and again across all eight primaries.
fee_convention: Market entry/market exit .0005 each side; resting take profit .0002. Fixed and normal adaptive development search exclude funding. Funding-aware BTC targets incorporate previously settled rates. Separate realized funding and marked-risk audits on eligible 2026 scenarios. Commissions are the project OKX account assumption on Binance USD-M price paths.
selection_clock: Entry at open following completed observation. Chronological first admission waits at least max(24 hours, planned maximum holding period). The original 30-minute directional notification cooldown does not remove eligible input bars.
case_classification: All specialized net-10000-point rules and any rule explicitly requiring the September admission are case-informed; the normal rank uses only earlier events. The frozen historical market periods had been examined in earlier studies.
price_control_caveat: Same-coin random clocks are matched separately for each basket member. Event inference is computed across distinct entry events with at least 80% of the original constituents represented. Strict controls additionally exclude shocks in the candidate holding window. Past-only sensitivity allows future shocks. The quarter-matched early-exit timing null uses exactly as many early exits per quarter as the observed rule.
funding_coverage_note: Funding settlements use exact REST marks where present, otherwise official same-hour mark K-line opens, including a same-day official daily archive when the monthly file omits a day. Keep original and renewed-breadth funded event coverage explicit.
